title: Granite Ridge Buddy Ticket and Guest Ticket Schedule
content:
Each tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme is published with three figures for guests skiing with the holder: the number of discounted buddy lift tickets loaded onto the pass at activation, the price the holder pays for each buddy ticket drawn from that allotment, and the percentage taken off a window lift ticket bought by the holder for a guest beyond the allotment.

| Tier | Buddy tickets loaded at activation | Buddy ticket price (USD) | Friends and family reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 0 | 149.00 | 0 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 2 | 129.00 | 10 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 4 | 119.00 | 15 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 6 | 109.00 | 20 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 8 | 99.00 | 25 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 10 | 89.00 | 30 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 16 | 79.00 | 35 per cent |

The buddy ticket price falls as the tier rises, from 149.00 on the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass to 79.00 on the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass, while the allotment rises from 0 to 16.

The Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass is published with an allotment of 0 and a friends and family reduction of 0 per cent; its buddy ticket price of 149.00 is published all the same, because the tariff carries a figure for every tier.
